Most toolbars can be customized by adding/removing/rearranging the buttons. Here's an article that describes how to do it:

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/unified-toolbar

By the way, you can always Send a message with the keyboard shortcut <Ctrl + Enter>.

content:
I don't really understand your description, but it sounds like you have accidentally changed the layout. Try the options found in the menu item <View | Layout> and see if you find a layout you like better. If the Menu Bar is hidden, press <Alt> or <F10> to reveal it.

You might have hidden the Message Pane. <F8> toggles it off and on.
creator: rednoise

content: Bug - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2077526. It's fixed, should land in release versions soon. As a workaround for now, you can drag and drop the file to be attached into the message.

If you're using either of these antivirus apps, try this:

AVG/AVAST: Menu > Settings > Basic Protection > Email Shield > disable 'Scan Inbound Emails'.

Bitdefender: go to Online threat prevention and disable 'Encrypted web scan'.
